item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00195","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C16","C12","C24"],"selected_candidate_label":"C16","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C16 plausibly supplied a concrete two-stage template: first designate a department head to administer statutory functions, then expressly authorize that official to redelegate those functions within the department. The child compresses the same machinery into two numbered paragraphs and repeats C16's distinctive cluster of terms—functions, responsibilities/duties, powers, authority, and discretion—while adapting the responsible department and statute. C12 has a similar Defense-specific delegation-and-redelegation sequence, but its operative language and confined redelegation are less closely aligned. C24 shares designation language and the same definition cluster but lacks the child’s second-stage delegation mechanism.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of Defense is hereby designated as the official to coordinate and facilitate such actions as may be required to discharge Federal responsibilities under the Federal Voting Assistance Act of 1955.","parent_excerpt":"the Attorney General shall carry out the functions provided for in that subsection, including the powers, duties, authority and discretion thereby vested in or conferred upon the President; and functions under the said subsection are hereby delegated to the Attorney General, and the Attorney General is hereby designated thereunder","explanation":"Both designate a department head to discharge responsibilities created by a specified statute."},{"child_excerpt":"the Secretary of Defense is hereby authorized to delegate any or all of the functions, responsibilities, powers, authority, or discretion devolving upon him in consequence of this order","parent_excerpt":"The Attorney General may delegate to any officer and agency of the Department of Justice such of his functions under this order as he may deem necessary.","explanation":"Both follow the initial assignment with express authority for intradepartmental redelegation of functions arising under the order."},{"child_excerpt":"functions, responsibilities, powers, authority, or discretion","parent_excerpt":"functions provided for in that subsection, including the powers, duties, authority and discretion","explanation":"The unusually comprehensive and closely ordered enumeration materially supports literal drafting reuse."}]}
